title: createRouteDiscovery
summary: Answer route discovery requests from the private manifest and a host authorizer.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: createRequestHandler calls this for its routeDiscovery option. Other hosts can call it directly with discoveryTarget: it returns a handler that takes the request and the route path.

sections.title: Matching
sections.body: Flat manifests match in build order; nested manifests match leaves with their layout chains like the browser router. Only protected routes in the matched chain are returned, after authorize allows every one of them.

sections.title: Denials
sections.body: Unknown, public and denied paths, and authorizers that throw, return the same 404 { routes: [] }. Non-GET/HEAD methods return 405. Every response is private, no-store.

sections.title: Validation
sections.body: The manifest is validated when the handler is created and an invalid one throws a TypeError, so misconfiguration fails at startup rather than per request.
